question: According to a provision in Article 124 of the Constitution of India, a Supreme Court judge can hold office till the age of ______ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __65__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the Constitution of India, a Supreme Court judge can hold office until they reach the age of 65. 
 
• The Constitution also states that a Supreme Court judge can be removed from office by the President if:
 
• There is an address from each House of Parliament 
 
• The address is supported by a majority of the total membership of that House 
 
• The address is supported by a majority of at least two-thirds of the members present and voting 
 
• The address is presented to the President in the same Session 
 
• The ground for removal is proved misbehavior or incapacity
